subject: Quick follow-up on your self-serve signup — a few questions + time options
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Amit Rao <amit@shoplio.com>
Cc: Katie Lin <katie@shoplio.com>
Date: 2028-07-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick follow-up on your self-serve signup — a few questions + time options

Hi Amit —

Thanks for signing up for Redwood and kicking the tires. I pulled your self-serve payload (attached as a quick CSV snapshot) and wanted to ask a couple brief questions so we make the demo practical for your team: 

- Primary use case: are you evaluating for chat/customer support augmentation, search/semantic ranking, or a mixture?
- Expected daily/peak traffic: can you share a ballpark of concurrent requests or tokens/day? The CSV had a sample of 50k tokens/day but no concurrency info.
- Timeline & milestones: when would you want to be live for an internal pilot and then broader rollout (weeks/months)?

If you’re good with a quick demo, I can do a 30-minute walkthrough (tailored to your use case) — available windows (PDT):
- Thu Jul 20 — 10:00–10:30 or 15:30–16:00
- Fri Jul 21 — 09:00–09:30 or 13:00–13:30

If none of those work, reply with a couple times that fit your calendar and we’ll adapt. Monica (cc’d) will join on the call to cover expected throughput and onboarding flows.

Attachments: selfserve_signup_summary.csv (fields: org, email, sample_requests_per_day), sample_traffic_snapshot.csv (sample request distribution)

Thanks — looking forward to learning more about your setup.

Cheers,
Dylan Brooks
Enterprise SDR | Redwood Inference
dylan.brooks@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Amit Rao <amit@shoplio.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Katie Lin <katie@shoplio.com>
Date: 2028-07-18T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up on your self-serve signup — a few questions + time options

Thanks Dylan — appreciate the quick follow. A few answers below: 

- Use case: customer support + short-form summarization for order threads (mostly chat interface).
- Volume: currently ~40k messages/month; peak concurrency for api calls is small (1–3 concurrent requests) but we expect that to grow if we roll it out across two additional teams.
- Timeline: pilot in ~6 weeks, broader rollout in ~3 months depending on pilot results.

The times you proposed look good but I’m in IST (UTC+5:30) so morning PDT is late evening for me. Katie (cc) handles procurement / scheduling and will propose a slot. If possible, can we do a recorded session and a short follow-up focused on throughput and billing assumptions?

— Amit
Amit Rao
Head of Product, Shoplio
amit@shoplio.com | +91 80 5555 9988

- Data sensitivity: will any of the data be regulated/PII-heavy (we can discuss VPC/private deployment options if so).

Katie — if you want, propose two preferred windows in IST and we’ll convert to PDT. I can propose a fallback on Wed Jul 19 at 21:00 IST (08:30 PDT) if that helps.

Best,
Dylan
